{{Quote|The Ministry of Logistics is responsible for our resupply, but my influence with Minister Khamarr has never been strong. She is a favorite of the Dark Council and rewards the needs of Dromund Kaas above all others.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="BoS:SftDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Shullis Khamarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the [[Minister of Logistics]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] as late as [[3643 BBY]].

==Biography==
[[Minister]] Khamarr was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as the [[Minister of Logistics|leader]] of the [[Ministry of Logistics]]. Khamarr was a favored minister of the [[Dark Council]], the Empire's governing body, and she made it her priority to serve the needs of those on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] led an [[Battle of Ord Radama|attack]] on the planet [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]], and the Ministry of Logistics was responsible for resupplying his forces. However, the supplies never arrived and Malgus lacked sufficient influence over Khamarr to compel her to help him.

Along with her friend [[Ula Vii]], they felt that the Sith Empire was a great civilizing power to lead to peace. After Vii went on a mission to the planet [[Sebaddon]], he contacted Khamarr again and told her that neither the Empire or the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] had possession of the world and they could take it during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|war]].
